declarations.name: AuiIcon
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI icon outlet: `<aui-icon name="calendar" size="sm" />`.
`name` is a registered icon name, a name resolved by the icon provider
(`provideAbsoluteUI({ icons })`), or an inline icon definition such as an icon of
`@absoluteui/icons/set`. Decorative unless `label` is set. Vector icons also take
`variant`, `colors`, `layers`, `overlays`, `container`, stroke, transform, and
animation inputs: colors, layers, stroke width, size, label, and `animationState`
update the rendered icon in place; the other inputs render it again. Animations run
in the browser only (the server renders the static icon) and stop when the
component is destroyed.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Registered icon name, or an icon definition (an icon of `@absoluteui/icons/set`, or one from an icon library adapter).

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Theme size xs to xl, a CSS length such as '20px', or a number of pixels (default: the surrounding icon size, or 1em).

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name. Omit for decorative icons; label icon-only buttons on the button instead.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: Variant of a vector icon (default `'outline'`); the icon must provide it.

inputs.name: colors
inputs.description: Role colors (CSS colors, validated), for example `{ accent: 'var(--aui-color-success-fg)' }`.

inputs.name: overlays
inputs.description: Up to two overlays (`@absoluteui/icons/set` overlays), one per anchor.

inputs.name: container
inputs.description: Draws the icon inside a circle or square.

inputs.name: strokeWidth
inputs.description: Outline stroke width in icon units, 0.5 to 4 (default: the inherited `--aui-icon-stroke-width`, else 2).

inputs.name: strokeScaling
inputs.description: `'fixed'` keeps strokes at their width in CSS pixels at any size.

inputs.name: dir
inputs.description: `'auto'` (default) mirrors directional icons in right-to-left layouts; `'ltr'` or `'rtl'` force a direction.

inputs.name: animation
inputs.description: An animation the icon lists (static by default; reduced motion is honored).

inputs.name: animationState
inputs.description: State for state-driven triggers: `loading`, `success`, and `error` play; `idle` stops.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the animation and shows the static end state.

types.name: AuiIconColors
types.description: Role colors for one icon instance.

types.name: AuiIconLayers
types.description: Per-layer color, opacity, or visibility for one icon instance.

types.name: AuiIconAnimation
types.description: Animation of an `aui-icon`; `host` defaults to the `aui-icon` element (hover, focus, and press triggers).
